A '''sail raft''' was a seafaring vessel deployed from [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]] when conditions required access to an area of [[Water/Legends|water]] that was otherwise inaccessible due to the barge's larger size.<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|13|Day of the Sepulchral Night (short story)}}</ref>
